behavior: A `pointerdown` listener that calls `preventDefault()` does not stop the swipe of a drawer or a toast. The call keeps its native meaning only: the browser sends no compatibility mouse events. An element in the popup or the toast stops the swipe with `data-vase-ui-swipe-ignore`, and a listener that calls `stopPropagation()` keeps the press from the part. Base UI starts no swipe from a press that a listener prevented.
